Here is a line-by-line transcription of the historical parish register page shown in **image_1edfa3.png**.

The document is written primarily in Latin (using standard formulaic phrasing for baptisms: *filius* for son, *filia* for daughter, *suscipiunt* / *suscep.* for godparents/sponsors) with standard 19th-century cursive abbreviations. Spelling variations of contemporary local names and placenames have been preserved exactly as written.
